title: Open a visible Classic target
description: Supply exactly one page, dialog, animeId, serverItem, sourceItem, libraryItem, aboutLink, system, entityId or path. page=settings accepts subpage (defaults about); page=media_library accepts subpage for library section. Settings and dialogs use existing Classic forms; user enters secrets. Dialog connection forms add a server; no credentials accepted. serverItem={provider:jellyfin|emby,itemId} uses the currently active Classic server. animeId supports direct positive or custom negative Classic IDs. sourceItem={provider:nipaplay|dandanplay_remote,animeId} opens Classic shared/remote details with its episode loader on the active Classic source. libraryItem={source:local|webdav|smb,animeId} follows the Classic library card: records recently opened, clears NEW baseline and passes its episode context. dialog=quarterly_comment requires reviewAnimeId from discover.home.review; opens the existing Bangumi editor when signed in. aboutLink=community|repository|qq_group|website|sponsor uses the Classic URL; qr=true displays its QR dialog (TV defaults to QR). system=harness|logs dispatches the existing system folder opener. External URLs/folders report OS acceptance, not visible window verification. dialog=video_picker|video_gallery initiates the existing Classic selection/play flow; user selects or cancels. video_gallery is mobile-only. Native picker visibility is outside Flutter observation. Returns opened=false with the reason when no current interface can display the target. Multiple playable locations return an executable choice; nothing opens until chosen.

subpage.description: For settings: appearance/language/general/storage/network/backup_restore/player/danmaku/external_player/shortcuts/remote_access/remote_media_library/downloader/developer_options/labs/plugins/about/webdav_quick. Only currently available Classic pages can open. For media_library: local_library/local_management/webdav_library/webdav_management/smb_library/smb_management/shared_library/shared_management/dandanplay/jellyfin/emby.

pluginId.description: Required only for dialog=plugin_readme. Use plugins.market IDs.
